merged_spine.spine_role: claim routes, OAK ledgers, protocols, dashboard, validation and freeze review

tracks.name: SP-CUBE Passive Lab
tracks.goal: turn passive delta-T protocol into a measured-candidate data path
tracks.success_gate: valid local dataset with baseline comparison
tracks.failure_gate: SP-CUBE sample does not beat baseline under logged conditions

tracks.name: Ark-M1 Low-Power Bench
tracks.goal: prepare a safe low-power thermal/energy bench
tracks.success_gate: stable low-power heat source and logged comparison
tracks.failure_gate: unstable power, sensor failure, unsafe heating or no measurable difference

tracks.name: Methane MRV
tracks.success_gate: unique event ID with before/repair/after evidence placeholders
tracks.failure_gate: missing uncertainty, missing repair evidence, duplicate event or source ambiguity

tracks.name: Public-Safe Dashboard
tracks.goal: display status, proof level, next gate and non-claims
tracks.success_gate: external reader sees limits before claims
tracks.failure_gate: dashboard implies certified performance or revenue

tracks.name: Thesis/Patent Route
tracks.success_gate: each invention-like idea has novelty/risk/evidence slots
tracks.failure_gate: legal or patent validity implied without review
tracks.oak_boundary: not legal advice or patent validation

tracks.name: Infra/Gov Graph Routing
tracks.goal: route GAIA/MRV events into infrastructure/governance graph formats
tracks.success_gate: event can become local review draft without remote mutation

tracks.name: Sensor Logger
tracks.goal: prepare ESP32 or Python serial logging scaffold
tracks.success_gate: timestamped temperature/power/environment log can be produced
tracks.failure_gate: uncalibrated data presented as certified measurement

tracks.name: Verified Sources
tracks.goal: replace citation TODOs with checked references
tracks.success_gate: each public claim maps to a source or a clear TODO

tracks.name: FailureSynth Expansion
tracks.goal: turn failure modes into local issue drafts and lint rules
tracks.success_gate: each high-risk claim has a failure mode and safe rewrite
tracks.failure_gate: failure mode is vague, untestable or not routed
tracks.oak_boundary: no remote issues without explicit confirmation
